name: Red Skull

moves.name: Knife Strike
moves.description: A fast combat-knife slash from Nazi close-quarters doctrine.

moves.name: Super-Soldier Blow
moves.description: A full-force strike from the cloned Rogers body.

moves.name: Luger Shot
moves.description: A precise pistol shot at a limb, a hostage, or a hero's gear.

moves.name: Dust of Death
moves.description: A cloud of red powder; kills unnamed mooks instantly, deals heavy damage and inflicts terror on heroes and named characters.

moves.name: Hydra Volley
moves.description: Orders present Hydra troops to concentrate fire on one target.

moves.name: Hostage Gambit
moves.description: Seizes a civilian or downed ally at knifepoint; heroes with protects-civilians-first must spend a round on Rescue.

moves.name: Ideological Taunt
moves.description: A cold speech that lowers enemy morale for two rounds; Captain America is immune.

moves.name: Parry and Riposte
moves.description: Reads an incoming melee attack, deflects it, and answers with a counter-strike.

moves.name: Smoke and Exit
moves.description: Drops a smoke charge and moves toward his pre-planned escape route; fails if the exit is blocked.

moves.name: Dead-Man Switch
moves.description: Triggers a pre-rigged device elsewhere in the city, forcing heroes to split or absorb a collateral event; only usable in an arc where the Showrunner placed the device.

leitmotif: A slow military march in a low minor key, snare-heavy, with a dissonant two-note skull motif that stabs over the top; the march thins to a single cold pulse when he is alone.
